styling.certification_note: Manufacturer certification claim; not an independent certificate-number audit. Certification does not mean zero odor.

styling.warranty: Limited lifetime; >1.5 inch visible indentation; first 10 years non-prorated, then 50%/60%/75% replacement charges in years 11-15/16-20/21+. Normal softening excluded; rental eligibility not affirmatively established.

trial.note: Eligibility/return fees and minimum break-in apply; retail trial is not a proven rental-use guarantee. Brooklyn cached FAQ/JSON-LD still says 120 nights/$99 fee while live page says 365; get current terms before relying on it.

durability_evidence.evidence_type: Sleep Foundation hands-on tests support medium-firm feel and value; current design lacks a multi-year rental cohort.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.

styling.name: Queen mattress · Brooklyn Bedding CopperFlex Hybrid 12 · Medium-firm
styling.dimension_basis: Official queen product measurements; IKEA actual dimensions distinguish nominal size.
styling.price_basis: Live selected queen sale; BF30 30% shown, code not checkout-tested; regular price 1065.0; tax excluded. Shipping not priced unless noted.
styling.materials: Copper-infused memory foam, comfort foams, zoned support and pocket coils.
styling.certification_note: Manufacturer certification claim; not an independent certificate-number audit. Certification does not mean zero odor.

fiberglass.basis: Manufacturer current product/gallery claim; Casper confirms new models fiberglass-free, older stock may differ.

styling.warranty: Limited lifetime; >1.5 inch visible indentation; first 10 years non-prorated, then 50%/60%/75% replacement charges in years 11-15/16-20/21+. Normal softening excluded; rental eligibility not affirmatively established.

trial.note: Eligibility/return fees and minimum break-in apply; retail trial is not a proven rental-use guarantee. Brooklyn cached FAQ/JSON-LD still says 120 nights/$99 fee while live page says 365; get current terms before relying on it.

durability_evidence.review_scope: Manufacturer/retailer product-family pooled reviews; variants and generations may be pooled, not rental failure rates.
durability_evidence.complaints_summary: Family reviews include feel/firmness mismatch; no reliable variant-specific sagging frequency established. Testers over 230 lb found inadequate support.
durability_evidence.evidence_type: Sleep Foundation hands-on tests support medium-firm feel and value; current design lacks a multi-year rental cohort.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.
cooling.assessment: Coil airflow preferable for mixed guests

platform_compatibility.project_rule: Use centre-supported platform, slat gaps <=3 inches; do not assume IKEA sprung slats or any named frame is already approved.

rental_fit.reason: Best value balance: coils, 12-inch height, emissions certifications; only $140 above foam sibling.
rental_fit.cleanability: Do not remove mattress fire-barrier/cover. Zip encasement plus washable fitted waterproof top protector; inspect seams/zip at turnover.
rental_fit.shipping: 3-6 business days to ship, compressed box; destination ETA unverified.
rental_fit.fit_note: Mattress top = slat deck elevation + 12 in; nightstand top should be mattress top minus 0-3 in. Frame overall height/headboard height is not deck elevation.

styling.materials: Copper-infused memory foam, comfort foams, zoned support and pocket coils.
styling.certification_note: Manufacturer certification claim; not an independent certificate-number audit. Certification does not mean zero odor.

fiberglass.basis: Manufacturer current product/gallery claim; Casper confirms new models fiberglass-free, older stock may differ.

styling.warranty: Limited lifetime; >1.5 inch visible indentation; first 10 years non-prorated, then 50%/60%/75% replacement charges in years 11-15/16-20/21+. Normal softening excluded; rental eligibility not affirmatively established.

trial.note: Eligibility/return fees and minimum break-in apply; retail trial is not a proven rental-use guarantee. Brooklyn cached FAQ/JSON-LD still says 120 nights/$99 fee while live page says 365; get current terms before relying on it.

durability_evidence.review_scope: Manufacturer/retailer product-family pooled reviews; variants and generations may be pooled, not rental failure rates.
durability_evidence.complaints_summary: Family reviews include feel/firmness mismatch; no reliable variant-specific sagging frequency established. Testers over 230 lb found inadequate support.
durability_evidence.evidence_type: Sleep Foundation hands-on tests support medium-firm feel and value; current design lacks a multi-year rental cohort.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.
cooling.assessment: Coil airflow preferable for mixed guests

platform_compatibility.project_rule: Use centre-supported platform, slat gaps <=3 inches; do not assume IKEA sprung slats or any named frame is already approved.

rental_fit.reason: Best value balance: coils, 12-inch height, emissions certifications; only $140 above foam sibling.
rental_fit.cleanability: Do not remove mattress fire-barrier/cover. Zip encasement plus washable fitted waterproof top protector; inspect seams/zip at turnover.
rental_fit.shipping: 3-6 business days to ship, compressed box; destination ETA unverified.
rental_fit.fit_note: Mattress top = slat deck elevation + 12 in; nightstand top should be mattress top minus 0-3 in. Frame overall height/headboard height is not deck elevation.

styling.placement: New six-sided zip encasement, queen 9–12-in depth; leave installed and use the separately washable top protector for turnover. Verify seller and commercial-use terms.

layouts.hero_view: Southwest pocket-door corner toward east bed wall: walnut queen, grey-oak RH pair, sage cotton and muted patterned rug, with workstation behind the camera.
removes: Guest room current contents excluded; surplus pieces stored, not discarded.
moves_to_other_room: RH pair and dining rug move into guest room; no current guest furniture retained.

other.purchase_gate: Tape uncertain owned sizes and deciding gaps before moving or ordering; nominal fit is not a measured pass.

rh_width_margin_in.basis: RH width +/-1 plus plan/jamb position +/-3; measure before moving

slider_route_margin_in.threshold: Tape clear north strip at least20 inches and recheck connected route.

other.closet_open_warning: Opening closet90degrees reduces route to18.7 inches; close it to pass. Everyday closet-closed route to slider21.5 inches.
other.drawers: RH drawers face west; no furniture in their18-inch pull scenario. Confirm tops22 inches suit actual mattress height.
other.owned_exclusions: No original guest room furniture, art, mirror, rug or gym reused.

geometry_script.method: 0.5-inch four-neighbour grid; analytic rectangle/segment distances; radius maximised on route; nominal scenario, not tape verified.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rugs below furniture, lamps on tables, wall decor and nook tabletop above bench seat are intentional vertical layers.

rental_checks.notes: Owned-material exemptions follow Round 12; geometry still applies. Item-only new purchases, no taxes or freight. Existing catalog links/prices retain original dated evidence; reconfirm stock before ordering. Visual service returned404 for the source contact sheet; finishes follow retained inventory descriptions, not a fresh image review.

layouts.rationale: Keep the household’s usable furniture, tie cognac, walnut, cream and pale oak together with washable olive accents, and buy only missing guest functions.
layouts.budget_basis: USD new purchases only; all owned pieces $0. Reused item models/sizes uncertain where marked. Existing catalog evidence retained, not a new stock confirmation.

styling.dimension_basis: Official queen product measurements; IKEA actual dimensions distinguish nominal size.
styling.price_basis: Live selected queen sale; BF30 30% shown, code not checkout-tested; regular price 1065.0; tax excluded. Shipping not priced unless noted.
styling.materials: Copper-infused memory foam, comfort foams, zoned support and pocket coils.
styling.certification_note: Manufacturer certification claim; not an independent certificate-number audit. Certification does not mean zero odor.

fiberglass.basis: Manufacturer current product/gallery claim; Casper confirms new models fiberglass-free, older stock may differ.

styling.warranty: Limited lifetime; >1.5 inch visible indentation; first 10 years non-prorated, then 50%/60%/75% replacement charges in years 11-15/16-20/21+. Normal softening excluded; rental eligibility not affirmatively established.

trial.note: Eligibility/return fees and minimum break-in apply; retail trial is not a proven rental-use guarantee. Brooklyn cached FAQ/JSON-LD still says 120 nights/$99 fee while live page says 365; get current terms before relying on it.

durability_evidence.review_scope: Manufacturer/retailer product-family pooled reviews; variants and generations may be pooled, not rental failure rates.
durability_evidence.complaints_summary: Family reviews include feel/firmness mismatch; no reliable variant-specific sagging frequency established. Testers over 230 lb found inadequate support.
durability_evidence.evidence_type: Sleep Foundation hands-on tests support medium-firm feel and value; current design lacks a multi-year rental cohort.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.
cooling.assessment: Coil airflow preferable for mixed guests

platform_compatibility.project_rule: Use centre-supported platform, slat gaps <=3 inches; do not assume IKEA sprung slats or any named frame is already approved.

rental_fit.reason: Best value balance: coils, 12-inch height, emissions certifications; only $140 above foam sibling.
rental_fit.cleanability: Do not remove mattress fire-barrier/cover. Zip encasement plus washable fitted waterproof top protector; inspect seams/zip at turnover.
rental_fit.shipping: 3-6 business days to ship, compressed box; destination ETA unverified.
rental_fit.fit_note: Mattress top = slat deck elevation + 12 in; nightstand top should be mattress top minus 0-3 in. Frame overall height/headboard height is not deck elevation.

waterproof.coverage: Six sides; not a fitted protector with open bottom.

fiberglass.basis: No added fire barrier claimed; manufacturer fiberglass declaration not retrieved. Accessory is not a mattress.

durability_evidence.review_scope: Pooled product/size reviews, not rental failure-rate tests.
durability_evidence.complaints_summary: Accessible owner comments include excess slack, difficult sizing and occasional stained arrival; no quantified failure rate.
durability_evidence.evidence_type: Manufacturer construction/warranty plus accessible owner reviews.

rental_fit.reason: Both recommended mattress heights fit 9–12 inches. SureGuard adds verified low-emission certification for only $5.97 more; SafeRest has explicit 2-year commercial terms.

layouts.hero_view: Hall doorway southeast corner, camera 50 inches, looking northwest: full queen, paired lights, the open slider, and real desk in separate frame.
removes: all existing movable furniture; no gym, cat furniture, desk or owner seating retained

windows.sash_access: Primary sash from clear side or over15–15.75-inch bedside top (22 quality/23.25 value), below stool underside26.7. Guest slider has full24.75/26-inch north strip; corrected west-wall luggage does not choke approach.

other.storage: 105-inch-wide reach-in closet, not a claim of measured drawer volume; retain shelves/hangers for two guests.
other.worst_case_note: Room metrology not tape-verified. Primary gap varies about +/-1.5 inches with room width; guest desk zone varies about +/-3 inches with depth. Tape before order; a nominal fit is not an as-built guarantee.
other.closet_open_pinch_note: 20.8-inch quality /20.35-inch value conservative disk path with closet open; closed is23.01 /23.5. Closet opening remains90 degrees; entry open too.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Closet interior shelves/drawers must be inventoried for month-long stays; no dresser is mandatory under council rules. Fixed-height contoured wood work chair is supportive but not an adjustable task chair; ergonomic upgrade remains an option, not an unverified fabric recommendation.
assembly_gates: Install required anti-tip restraints before letting (primary chest).
Measure assembled mattress top: target23.25–26.25 inches, so nightstand is never above mattress. Slat spacing/load and warranty-for-rental not independently certified.
GRUSNARV is fitted waterproof protection, not a zippered encasement; full bedbug encasement remains an optional unsourced procurement upgrade.
Test sealed blackout peel-away and normal exterior-opening operation; do not obstruct bedroom escape.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.

layouts.rationale: East is the only uninterrupted headboard wall: north is the slider, west the bathroom/pocket and south the closet. Omit a dresser rather than pinch the desk chair; the 105-inch reach-in closet supplies monthly hanging/shelf storage.

removes: All existing movable furniture; no reuse assumed.

hard_rules: Task chair lacks a captured Wyzenbeek >=30000 and W/WS cleaning code for the exact selected upholstery; NOT rental-certified.

Nightstand/mattress alignment depends on unmeasured bed deck.
rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

styling.price_basis: Live exact queen offer; tax excluded. SureGuard advertises free shipping; Amazon Prime/destination conditions apply.

waterproof.coverage: Six sides; not a fitted protector with open bottom.
waterproof.limit: Not physically spill-tested here. Follow low-heat laundering; punctures/zip gaps defeat protection.

bed_bug_protection.basis: Independent lab testing claimed by SureGuard, Invisi-Zip/SureSeal closure.

fiberglass.basis: No added fire barrier claimed; manufacturer fiberglass declaration not retrieved. Accessory is not a mattress.

trial.note: No mattress sleep trial. Return policy subject to condition/vendor; verify before opening.

rental_fit.reason: Both recommended mattress heights fit 9–12 inches. SureGuard adds verified low-emission certification for only $5.97 more; SafeRest has explicit 2-year commercial terms.
rental_fit.cleanability: Leave zip encasement installed; use a separately washable fitted waterproof protector over it for fast turnover. Inspect zipper and membrane each turnover.
rental_fit.fit_note: Does NOT fit 13.25-inch Signature Hybrid: select 13–16-inch SureGuard or 12–15-inch SafeRest separately. 7.875-inch VESTERÖY needs 6–8-inch encasement.
rental_fit.shipping: SureGuard orderable, free shipping advertised; delivery date unverified.

Quality uses22-inch-high Miles Mini tables (16x15), not the taller value23.25-inch TONSTAD; price449 each last checked16November.
assembly_gates: Install required anti-tip restraints before letting (primary chest).

GRUSNARV is fitted waterproof protection, not a zippered encasement; full bedbug encasement remains an optional unsourced procurement upgrade.
Test sealed blackout peel-away and normal exterior-opening operation; do not obstruct bedroom escape.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. rental_checks.conditional_measurement: Clear room depth must be at least142.35 inches to retain30-inch desk-chair zone with this23.6-inch desk and fixed bed position; nominal143.5 +/-3 makes this conditional. Value18.5-inch desk is the robust fallback.
